bounded_seams: The PC23 fixture models the pinned Recent Files handlers' rename and delete outcomes alongside a stale missing entry, with a renamed valid note and a deletable existing note.

The workflow-only worker applies rename, stale filtering and delete to a read-only in-memory projection, preserves event order and configured maxLength, and records the final valid entry without invoking vault writes or the unchanged callbacks.
The audit requires stale removal, rename update, delete removal, retained entry, order, maxLength and zero-write checks in install/restart/update phases.
implementation.security_disposition: Direct vault writes, filesystem/network/process/credential access and privileged DOM remain denied. Rename/delete behavior is a bounded projection only; no unchanged-plugin vault mutation callback is invoked.
